_description: Secondary SHA3-256 vectors (spec/VERIFICATION.md V2-11 and its erratum of 27/10/2026). Assemble each case as { bundle: { dcp_bundle_version: "2.0", manifest, ...base.artifacts, audit_entries }, signature } and verify it with the default verifier policy at verification_time. expect "accept": it MUST verify. expect "reject": it MUST fail with an error that contains error_contains, and its control (the same entries without secondary fields, primary chain and root recomputed, signed again) MUST verify.
